dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Could you tell me what happened to the Eremites from earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Oh, sure. Sedile contacted the Gardes. They should be in the Maison Gardiennage's custody by now.

dialogues.speaker: Virda
dialogues.text: Sedile said that the Marechaussee Phantom is in charge of finding the bad guys — and in the cases that they've been found, we can just directly hand them over to the Maison!
